The '''Aldo Spachian system''',<ref name="SL" /> also known as the '''Aldo Spach system''',<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|19|Aldo Spach}}</ref><ref name="TEA" /> was a binary [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="SL" /> located in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was known for the legendary beauty of the famous [[Aldo Spachian Comet]].<ref name="SL" />
